September 13", 2026

Dear Commissioners,

| respectfully request that the Public Utility Commission of Texas conduct an audit and
comprehensive review of Project Raptor Permit #59142 to ensure compliance with all
application regulations and to evaluate its potential impact on nearby residents and
agricultural operations.

This proposed project is situated in the middle of hundreds of homes and large tracts of
production agriculture. We share a fence line and have many concerns that could affect
our way of life; including noise, lighting, traffic and other disruptions that may affect young
children, the medically vulnerable, livestock and the rural character of our community. |
have particular concerns about impacts on cattle, horses and other livestock, as well as
potential declines in quality of life and property enjoyment.

| request that the Commission review any impact on electric reliability, infrastructure
costs, and Texas ratepayers and verify that all studies, disclosures, and regulatory
requirements have been fully met. Given the significant public interest in this project, | also
ask that the Commission make its findings publicly available and provide opportunities for
community input throughout the review process.

Thank you for your consideration and for your commitment to protecting Texas
Communities through transparent regulatory oversight.

Respectfully,

Dear Commissioners,




I respectfully requestthatthe Public Utility Commission of Texas conductan auditand
comprehensive review of Project Raptor Permit #59142 to ensure compliance with all
application regulationsandtoevaluate its potential impacton nearby residents and
agriculturaloperations.

This proposed project is situated in the middte of hundreds of homes and large tracts of
production agriculture. We share a fence line and have manyconcernsthat could affect
our way of life; including noise, lighting, traffic and other disruptions that may affect young
children, the medicallyvulnerable, livestockand the ruralcharacter of ourcommunity. I
have particular concerns about impacts on cattle, horses and other livestock, as well as
potential declines in quality of life and property enjoyment.

I requestthatthe Commission review anyimpact on electric reliability, infrastructure
costs, and Texas ratepayers and verify that all studies, disclosures, and regulatory
requirements have been fully met. Given the significant public interest in this project, I also
askthatthe Commission make its findings publiclyavailableand provide opportunities for
communityinputthroughout the review process.

Thank you for yourconsideration and foryourcommitment to protecting Texas
Communitiesthroughtransparent regulatoryoversight.




Respectfully,
